## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load Data

We are gonna be using the `biopsy` dataset. It is a breast cancer dataset from the University of Wisconsin Hospitals, Madison. The dataset contains biopsies of breast tumors for 699 patients. The nine attributes was scored on a scale of 1 to 10. The true outcome of the biopsies are also known (benign/malignant).

```{r}
biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
biopsy
```
